justification.account_number: policy ACCOUNTNUM; same as Gretel bban
justification.customer_id/employee_id: same as the Gretel mapping -> PERSONALREF
justification.fax_number: a fax line is a telephone-format number; policy TELEPHONENUM covers phone numbers
justification.medical_record_number/health_plan_benefi: policy PERSONALREF covers patient and membership reference numbers tied to a person
justification.national_id: IDCARDNUM; ssn -> SOCIALNUM; tax_id -> TAXNUM; date_of_birth -> DATEOFBIRTH; age -> AGE; credit_debit_card -> CREDITCARDNUMBER; user_name -> USERNAME
justification.street_address: street-level postal address -> ADDRESS (same as the Gretel street_address mapping)

label_source: spans column (Python-literal list of start/end/label/text); the README names the categories only generally (names, SSNs, MRNs, addresses, phones, emails, account numbers) and lists no label table, so the label list was read from the data itself (label counts only).

out_of_scope_reasons.city/state/county/postcode/country/coord: coarse geography alone is not a complete postal routing address; policy says public places in general are not masked (same choice as Gretel, where only street_address is in scope)
out_of_scope_reasons.company_name/occupation/employment_statu: organizations and non-identifying attributes, no policy label (URLs scored as out of scope, not as email)
out_of_scope_reasons.date/time/date_time: generic calendar dates and times are do-not-mask in the policy
out_of_scope_reasons.ipv4/ipv6/mac_address/device_identifier/: device, vehicle or other identifiers without a matching policy label (certificate/licence numbers are professional, not driving licences)
out_of_scope_reasons.password/pin/cvv/api_key/http_cookie/ban: credentials and bank routing codes: no policy label (same as Gretel OUT)
out_of_scope_reasons.race_ethnicity/gender/sexuality/politica: sensitive attributes without a policy label

policy_note: Policy labels and their definitions come from configs/privacy-policy-v1.json. A source label is in scope only when it clearly is one of the 16 policy labels; everything else is out of scope (neither recall nor excess; the share that still got masked is reported). All annotated spans (in and out of scope) count as annotated for excess.
